_note: Genre is what a collection is, in the language a viewer would use, and is not the same as medium: PixelArcade's medium is acrylic on panel, its genre is painting and design. A statement replaces the collection's line on its page and its card; a card_statement replaces only the card, for when the page wants the fuller version. Group and cover overrides move a collection or change its face. All of it is applied during the split, so a catalog rebuild does not have to run.

pixelarcade.card_statement: Arcade games in their essential form: pixels.
pixelarcade.statement: PixelArcade winnows each game down to its essential color palette... sampled from the canonical on-screen palette and arranged into a fixed grid. Painting pixels shifts their context: from a childhood game to a fine artwork with both personal and shared lineage. We all had our favorite games growing up. That's the joy I'm trying to recreate here.
